summary: Globavend Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the expiration of all outstanding Series A Warrants on June 30, 2026, which were issued in a June 2025 public offering. The company had previously exercised all Series B Warrants in July 2025. No new securities transactions, acquisitions, divestitures, or other special-situation events occurred. The filing is a routine update on the company's capital structure simplification, with no board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms. This is an ordinary corporate update, not a special situation.
